name: Time Loop Nibiru
detailed_description:
Third-person shooter in an alternate universe in a sci-fi setting with elements of metroidvania

The protagonist finds himself in a time loop on the planet Nibiru. Your task is to break the time loop by solving the mystery of the conspiracy, passing all possible endings and fly away from the planet.

The plot of the game takes place in an alternate universe. Humanity has gone far in development and is capable of interstellar flights and thus colonized many planets in the galaxy. There are three main factions in the galaxy.

The plot of the game begins with the fact that you are part of the Federation expedition to the controversial planet Nibiru in the laboratory of the “blue” Federation, but there is a crash of the planet's spaceship and you are still captured in a time loop, where every certain time there is an explosion in the laboratory, which kills all around, while the laboratory is drawn into a civil war between the “red” workers under the protectorate of the Empire and the local “green” colonists of the Confederation. And an imperial cruiser has also been spotted in orbit. The local semi-wild aliens will not be left out.

The game is created by one person and published by his own forces. Anyone who wants to help and support the game, write to the post.
